story.title: The Khashika Spirit
story.subtitle: A tradition of Indian jewelry since 1924
story.heritageText1: Since 1924, Khashika has perpetuated the ancestral art of Indian jewelry. Each piece we create carries within it the soul of millennial traditions, passed down from generation to generation.
story.heritageText2: Our artisans, heirs to age-old techniques such as Kundan and Meenakari, shape each jewel with a passion that transcends time. Solid silver, the noble material par excellence, becomes under their expert hands a unique work of art.
story.kundanText1: Kundan, an emblematic technique of Mughal jewelry, consists of setting precious stones in pure gold. At Khashika, we adapt this ancestral technique to solid silver, creating pieces of timeless elegance.
story.kundanText2: Each stone is carefully chosen: turquoise, lapis lazuli, carnelian, so many gems that tell a story, that of eternal India.
story.meenakariText1: Meenakari, the art of enameling on metal, brings to our creations a palette of vibrant colors. Floral and geometric motifs, inspired by Mughal and Rajasthani art, adorn our jewelry with incomparable beauty.
story.meenakariText2: Each color is applied by hand, each motif drawn with precision, making each piece a unique work, a witness to exceptional craftsmanship.
story.commitmentText1: At Khashika, we believe in fair and sustainable trade. Our artisans are fairly compensated, and we are committed to preserving traditional techniques while innovating to meet contemporary expectations.
story.commitmentText2: Each jewel you wear tells a story: that of India, its traditions, its artisans, and now, yours.
story.ctaText: Explore our collection of handcrafted jewelry, each carrying a unique story.
